name: manual_2862a1
claim: Once a request may have been sent, never release its reservation: after Popen succeeds the request counts as sent, so a failure releases nothing and settles unknown, and if settling itself fails leave the reservation to its declared hold and surface the error. A sent request must never be recorded as zero spend.
